title: Atomic layer deposition of Ru nanoclusters on Ba–LaCeOx: a highly efficient catalyst for ammonia synthesis under mild conditions.
rationale: 气相N₂/H₂合成氨与ALD制备直接交叉；温度信息不等于焦耳热。

title: Numerical investigation of a Joule-heated catalytic reactor for enhanced ammonia decomposition to hydrogen.
rationale: 标题明确是氨分解反应器模拟；可迁移电热设计，但不是N₂/H₂合成氨正例。

title: Electrified dry reforming of methane via direct Joule heating of Ni/Al2O3 washcoated SiSiC foams towards ultra-high space velocity operation.
rationale: CH₄/CO₂干重整的直接焦耳供热与涂层床结构可迁移；不能当合成氨性能。

title: Electrified reverse water-gas shift via direct Joule heating of Mo-based conductive catalysts.
rationale: 反向水煤气变换不是制氨；导电催化供热属可迁移方法。

title: Enhanced C–O Functionality on Carbon Papers Ensures Lowering Nucleation Delay of ALD for Ru towards Unprecedented Alkaline HER Activity.
rationale: Ru在碳上ALD成核对本课题可迁移，碱性HER不是合成氨；没有焦耳供热证据。

title: Experimental discovery of novel ammonia synthesis catalysts via active learning.
rationale: 仅这个标题能确认制氨催化剂主动学习，不能从DOI记忆补出气相/电化学及加热方式；待摘要明确反应路线。

title: Machine-Learned Force Field for Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Nonequilibrium Ammonia Synthesis on Iron Catalysts.
rationale: 题名支持铁催化非平衡MD/MLFF，未明确进料路线；non-equilibrium不等于Joule或PHQ。

title: Joule-Heated Catalytic Reactors toward Decarbonization and Process Intensification: A Review.
rationale: 电热反应器综述直接帮助平台设计，但不能仅凭题名算气相合成氨交叉实证。

title: Operating envelope of Haber–Bosch process design for power-to-ammonia.
rationale: Haber–Bosch明确目标气相路线；power-to-ammonia不等于催化床焦耳加热。

title: Inherent strain and kinetic coupling determine the kinetics of ammonia synthesis over Ru nanoparticles.
rationale: 题名可确认Ru制氨动力学主题，未提供进料或过程细节；不依据R126编号或DOI反查补标签。

title: Promoter effects on Ru catalysts for gas-phase ammonia synthesis from N2 and H2
rationale: 直接目标反应；未交代加热器时不补推焦耳热或外炉。

title: 程序升温与快速淬冷调制Fe表面N₂/H₂气相合成氨的微观动力学
rationale: 明确的温度程序与N₂/H₂气相路线形成交叉；不能只追Ru而漏Fe，也不能把程序加热擅自确定为焦耳供热或实验性能。

title: Joule-heating synthesis of Ru/carbon catalysts for ammonia production
rationale: 制备与反应两个阶段要分开，关联很强却不构成焦耳热驱动合成氨。

title: Joule-heated Ru/carbon catalysts for ammonia production
rationale: 与上一例近似题名，但上下文明确反应时的供热。

title: ALD alumina overcoats stabilize ruthenium during N2/H2 ammonia synthesis
rationale: 包覆/界面ALD直接交叉，未必都是负载金属。

title: ALD improves catalytic performance
rationale: 缩写和性能过于模糊，无进料、材料、ALD展开及用途；不能仅凭ALD三个字强行分类。

title: Electrochemical reduction of nitrogen to ammonia in aqueous electrolyte
rationale: 产物同为NH₃，但过程不同；保留邻近背景，不进入直接气相池。

title: Selective ammonia production by electrochemical nitrate reduction
rationale: 应同时排除N₂原料和气相热催化误认。

title: Bimetallic nanoparticles for hydrolytic hydrogen release from ammonia borane
rationale: ammonia borane不是ammonia synthesis，不能只匹配ammonia。

title: 导电泡沫直接电阻加热驱动氨裂解制氢
rationale: 中文氨裂解同分解，方向必须识别；电热装置可迁移。

title: Flash Joule heating prepares metal nanoparticles for aqueous dye degradation
rationale: 保留快速制备方法线索，不算电热反应或合成氨性能。

title: Flash Joule conversion of waste carbon to conductive graphitic supports
rationale: 用户关心导电碳和载体，属可迁移材料方法；不得虚构催化活性。

title: Pulsed-current electrochemical N2 reduction for ammonia synthesis
rationale: pulse/current并不自动等于PHQ或焦耳热，需要热量证据。

title: Protein folding with neural networks
rationale: 不能把来源名Joule当热方法；泛ML不能绕过领域过滤。

title: ALD biomarkers in alcoholic liver disease
rationale: 医学缩写不是atomic layer deposition。

title: Gene therapy for X-linked ALD
rationale: 不同医学ALD也应排除，不能只硬编码一条liver disease。

title: Atomic layer deposition of gate dielectrics for a commercial memory-chip node
rationale: 真ALD不等于对用户必然有用；此控制句明确无可迁移方法，主题词可保留但默认动态池排除。

title: Self-limiting ALD nucleation of ruthenium on functionalized carbon nanotubes
rationale: 有明确材料/自限制方法可迁移，不因缺合成氨关键词漏掉，也不伪称活性论文。

title: 原位红外结合15N2同位素验证Ru催化气相合成氨的氮来源
rationale: 真实氮源与定量对用户重要，不能只收性能突破或材料制备。

title: A new large language model beats stock-trading benchmarks
rationale: 泛AI及股价资讯不进入科研主题动态。

title: Bayesian optimization of promoter loading for gas-phase N2/H2 ammonia synthesis
rationale: AI确实服务目标实验，不应与泛AI一起排除。

title: Electric-field-assisted gas-phase ammonia synthesis over Ru
rationale: 电场效应不等于焦耳供热交叉，需保留供热角色区分。

title: Calibrating emissivity and hot spots in Joule-heated SiSiC catalytic foams
rationale: 测温方法可迁移，不能因不是NH₃而漏掉，也不能把温度图当合成氨成果。

title: DFT and microkinetics of N2 dissociation and hydrogen inhibition during gas-phase N2/H2 ammonia synthesis on Ru
rationale: 相关计算应进入直接池，但需保持模型证据不等于实验。

title: Photocatalytic nitrogen fixation to ammonia using water under visible light
rationale: 光催化氮固定不能混为目标气相路线。

title: Non-thermal plasma synthesis of ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen
rationale: 即使N₂/H₂相同，非热等离子体仍须与目标热催化路线分开。

title: Ammonia refrigeration in a supermarket cold-storage system
rationale: ammonia+temperature并不构成催化动态。

title: Recent advances in ammonia synthesis
rationale: 无摘要的宽标题可能含多条路线，不能强贴气相正例；保留待核查而非直接丢弃。

title: Electrified ammonia production
rationale: electrified可能指上游制氢、外部供热、电化学或电热床，题名不足。

title: ALD and AI for next-generation energy systems
rationale: 两个缩写与能源宽泛词不支持材料、过程及相关层级精确判断。
